items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And you've got Count Basie and all them different territory bands that was out there, hitting.

ctx.x: Thad Jones used to come down there then. Well, Thad Jones got fired from messing around--down there messing around with us. He wouldn't go to work. He came down there playing with us every night. And, you know, when he decided to go to work, he didn't have no job.

No, he was--he came down there with a show. He was working on Miami Beach. I forgot the name of the band he was working with. And I'll tell you another guy used to come and set in with us by the name of Ray Perry.
